parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood. It provides the overall shape and support for the storage compartments.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the cabinet doors, shelves, and top surface, ensuring stability and durability of the furniture.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a flat panel made of MDF, attached to the frame with hinges and equipped with a handle for opening and closing.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the storage compartments inside the cabinet and protects the contents from dust and view.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates about its hinges to open and close.
